name: voice-assistant
description: Real-time voice AI assistant powered by Amazon Nova Sonic

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "uvicorn server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000 --reload --app-dir backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
